pages.text: FROM: DOLORES$(br)TO: All Staff$(br)RE: Hands$(br2)Without a Manipulator Arm a jar cannot mine, place, fight, use items or pick things up. Doors and chests do not answer.
pages.title: MEMO

pages.text: A bare jar can still:$(li)use every Noggin & Sons machine$(li)step back into its own body$(li)board a boat or minecart$(li)ride a host$(li)use its keys and modules$(li)pick up with a Magnet
Hands: half speed, half damage, 200 FE a block or hit.
